quotes.text: I always say this is the birth of Beyoncé. She didn't need [the writers] there to hold her hand.
We had no idea that The Writing's on the Wall would be as big a record as it was. Especially worldwide.
It was a neo-soul record and we were 15 years old. It was way too mature for us.
For me, it is about amplifying the beauty in all of us.
